core_observability_vectors.name: fault_is_terminal_not_source_retry
core_observability_vectors.machine_source:
format: 1
namespace: example.transaction_server

events:
  new_request:
    direction: input
    payload:
      transaction_id: { type: string, required: true }
  received:
    direction: input
  authorized:
    direction: input
  priority_request:
    direction: input
  retry:
    direction: input

machines:
  - machine_id: transaction_server
    root:
      type: composite
      deferred_event_capacity: 0
      initial: { transition_to: idle }
      states:
        idle:
          on_events:
            new_request: { transition_to: busy.receiving }
        busy:
          type: composite
          deferred_events: [new_request]
          initial: { transition_to: busy.receiving }
          on_events:
            priority_request: { transition_to: idle }
          states:
            receiving:
              on_events:
                received: { transition_to: busy.authorizing }
            authorizing:
              deferred_events: [priority_request, retry]
              on_events:
                new_request: {}
                retry: { guard: "false" }
                authorized: { transition_to: idle }

core_observability_vectors.name: internal_emission_retained
core_observability_vectors.machine_source:
format: 1
namespace: conformance.case_09_parallel_components
events:
  fanout:
    direction: input
  finish_left:
    direction: input
  finish_right:
    direction: input
  enter_faulty:
    direction: input
  cancel_after_send:
    direction: input
  cleanup_rollback:
    direction: input
  enter_cleanup:
    direction: input
  aggregate_finish:
    direction: input
  component_work:
    direction: internal
  component_finish:
    direction: internal
machines:
  - machine_id: parallel_components
    version: 1
    root:
      type: composite
      initial: { transition_to: processing }
      states:
        processing:
          type: parallel
          on_events:
            fanout:
              action:
                - send:
                    event: component_work
                    targets:
                      - { component: left }
                      - { component: right }
            finish_left:
              action:
                - send:
                    event: component_finish
                    to: { component: left }
            finish_right:
              action:
                - send:
                    event: component_finish
                    to: { component: right }
            cancel_after_send:
              action:
                - send:
                    event: component_work
                    to: { component: left }
              transition_to: finished
            done: { transition_to: finished }
            determa.component_completed: {}
          components:
            - component_id: left
              root:
                type: composite
                variables:
                  trace: { type: list, init: [] }
                initial: { transition_to: running }
                states:
                  running:
                    on_events:
                      component_work:
                        action:
                          - assign: { trace: "trace + ['left']" }
                      component_finish:
                        action:
                          - send:
                              event: component_work
                              to: { self: true }
                        transition_to: complete
                  complete: { type: final }
            - component_id: right
              root:
                type: composite
                variables:
                  trace: { type: list, init: [] }
                initial: { transition_to: running }
                states:
                  running:
                    on_events:
                      component_work:
                        action:
                          - assign: { trace: "trace + ['right']" }
                      component_finish:
                        action:
                          - send:
                              event: component_work
                              to: { self: true }
                        transition_to: complete
                  complete: { type: final }
        finished: { type: final }
        cleanup_failed:
          type: parallel
          on_events:
            cleanup_rollback:
              action:
                - send:
                    event: component_work
                    to: { component: retained }
              transition_to: finished
          exit:
            - assign: { cleanup_marker: "1 / 0" }
          variables:
            cleanup_marker: { type: int, init: 0 }
          components:
            - component_id: retained
              root: {}
            - component_id: retained_peer
              root: {}
        faulty_processing:
          type: parallel
          entry:
            - send:
                event: component_work
                to: { component: faulty }
          components:
            - component_id: faulty
              root:
                variables:
                  count: { type: int, init: 0 }
                entry:
                  - assign: { count: "count % 0" }
            - component_id: observer
              root: {}
      on_events:
        enter_faulty: { transition_to: faulty_processing }
        enter_cleanup: { transition_to: cleanup_failed }
        aggregate_finish:
          action:
            - send:
                event: component_work
                to: { self: true }
            - stop: {}

core_observability_vectors.name: migration_disposal_is_explicit

delivery-v1-cases.description: Closed delivery boundary responses. Admission and terminal responses resolve exact operation receipts; deferred/recall responses resolve live mailbox entries without new receipts; outbound responses resolve pending/terminal outbox records without new receipts. All linked checkpoint snapshots and digests are normative.

execution-checkpoint-transfer-v1.description: Exact creation, committed admission, and terminal unhandled checkpoint snapshots for examples/portable-event-deferral.yaml. The admitted event received-1 is declared input but has no handler in idle. Response loss and equal redelivery do not change after_admission.

queue-placement-checkpoints-v1.description: Complete §17 checkpoint snapshots for a real portable-event-deferral.yaml trajectory: request-1 handled from idle into busy.receiving, request-2 admitted and deferred, received-1 admitted and handled into busy.authorizing, then request-2 structurally recalled. Deferral and recall add no operation receipt.

outbound-checkpoint-lifecycle-v1.description: Alternative §17.6 outbound updates from the same committed effect checkpoint. No update allocates a new operation receipt; the original creation receipt continues to reference the effect.

outbound-destination-receipts-v1.description: Host-retained destination acceptance and dead-letter transfer receipts bound to the alternative terminal §17.6 checkpoints. The destination must itself confirm durable responsibility.
